description: Minister of Transport Highways Port and Civil Aviation - Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers Serving on Board Ships Engaged on Domestic Voyages) Regulations No.04 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing legal standards for training, certification and watchkeeping for seafarers on domestic voyages. It creates a new regulatory framework with specific legal requirements and compliance standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather on the substantive legal regulations being promulgated.
